column3: NKJV names “Peter” and adds “from the beginning,” representing the Greek “having begun.”
NKJV has “where I was,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “where we were.”
NKJV includes “men,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Send to Joppa.”
Close to the Greek; “tribulation” is rendered “persecution.”
NKJV names “Barnabas,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “he went to Tarsus.”
NKJV includes “Caesar,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “in the time of Claudius.”
Close to the Greek; “ministry” is rendered “relief.”
